author: Wirp
body:
• Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) : ZakkyZak (Old name: Zakko_12)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: I was lagging, but staff thought I was using anti knockback
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I've been loving this server since I started playing on it, and it's my life. And as I told you, I was lagging.

    • Any post that does not follow this guideline will be automatically locked. Also try not to spam us with 1000 appeals either. It doesn't help.

    There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
    • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? It was false, I was lagging. I have no proof
    • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?: No, I don't have
    • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? I've been waiting for 1,5 years now
    • Have I been caught ban evading? : I'm sorry, but I really suck at english. But I guess the answer from me is: No
    • Have I appealed a ban before? : Never
    When it comes to appealing an infraction. The only thing that helps it is the amount of time you serve that infraction.

    Do not expect to be appealed a day after you ban if you know that it wasn't a false ban. You must face the consequences.

    Regarding second appeals:
    Each player only gets one chance when it comes to hacking. If you have already appealed once for hacking and you end up getting banned the second time, do not expect the second appeal to go well. They will most likely be denied automatically.

    Regarding ban evasion:
    Well of course if you evade a ban the second account will be banned. If this happens chances of appealing it will be 0.
    When evading a temp ban via an alt account, we will be banning both accounts from the server, so don't do it.

replies.body:
Hello Zakky

I'm going to appeal your punishment as the staff member that banned you is no longer one and you have waited a very decent amount of time to get unbanned. Nevertheless, make sure you read the rules again (some things have changed) so that you don't get any other infraction on here.

Have fun on our servers! Regards,
Javi
